regime_context: This is a mean-reverting A-share tape where the detector's one validated edge (trend gate) did NOT hold historically (gate_helps=false), and the backtest verdict explicitly labels everything else as display-only. Leadership is one-narrative (Banks only, breadth 1.0, crowded, 9% of universe eligible) with no confirmed handoff — so the honest read is very low conviction and mostly 'avoid' on previously crowded-lagging groups, plus a single modest conditional on the lone durable leader.
emerging_watch: Watch Coal (515220.SS) for a confirmed handoff: if Coal's breadth expands above 0.7 while holding eligibility and a crowding_z below 1.0 for two consecutive weeks, the one-narrative Banks regime is ending. Retire this watch if Coal loses eligibility or its score crosses back below 0.9 before 2026-11-02.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the sole eligible theme with true breadth (1.0), the only hurst_tag='trend' with a high durability_bar (0.83), and are the confirmed one-narrative leader. On a mean-reverting tape where the gate has no edge, the trend-health leg is coincident focus, not alpha — so this is expressed only as a conditional lean, not conviction. Crowding_z 1.85 is a size-down caution, never a fade.
theses.dissent: Banks are crowded (z=1.85) and this is exactly the documented failure mode: attention spikes and one-narrative dominance mark tops in a mean-reverting A-share tape. With dir_accuracy 0.337 on 89 calls, the last thing to trust is a crowded leader continuing.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the only other eligible theme, ranked #2 with score 1.038 and not crowded (z=0.72). Its hurst_tag is 'mean-revert' with a mediocre durability_bar (0.55) and breadth only 0.5, which argues against chasing it as a new leader. The lean is only conditional: if the Banks narrative stalls and Coal's breadth widens, it is the only confirmed challenger within the narrow eligible set.
theses.dissent: Coal has a mean-revert tag and half the breadth of Banks — on a whipsawing tape it could just as easily rotate back down. There is no confirmed leadership handoff (directional=false in rotation), so this is effectively a bet on a challenger that has not yet taken over.

theses.subject: Solar / Photovoltaics
theses.thesis: Solar is the weakest scorable theme (score -0.698, rank 21) with the most negative crowding_z (-2.22) and near-zero breadth (0.067). On a tape where the trend gate provides no drawdown protection (gate_helps=false), an avoid lean is a de-risking posture, not a short or fade — the guardrails forbid fading the leader, but avoiding a deeply negative, non-eligible laggard is a different, safer expression.
evidence: crowding_z=-2.22, the most negative in the set
theses.dissent: Avoid calls on deeply negative themes can miss mean-reversion snaps in a mean-reverting market — the very reason gate_helps=false. Solar could bounce precisely because it is oversold and unloved.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
